nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 token contract being held by the timelock
Immutable beneficiary address that receives tokens after release
Immutable timestamp when token release is enabled
Constructor validating releaseTime_ > block.timestamp and initializing _token, _beneficiary, _releaseTime
Public view returning the held ERC20 token (_token)
Public view returning the beneficiary address (_beneficiary)
Public view returning the release timestamp (_releaseTime)
Public function that checks block.timestamp >= releaseTime, reads the contract balance and transfers tokens to the beneficiary
Public view returning the token balance currently held by the timelock
block.timestamp, used as the time gate for release and validated in the constructor
External call token().safeTransfer(beneficiary(), amount) which transfers control to the token contract
Constructor parameter for the ERC20 token address, assigned to _token
Constructor parameter for the beneficiary address, assigned to _beneficiary
Constructor parameter for the release timestamp, assigned to _releaseTime and compared against block.timestamp
Local variable in release() holding the timelock's token balance to be transferred
Local variable in getLockedAmount() holding the timelock's token balance

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is assigned to the immutable state variable _token
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned to the immutable state variable _beneficiary
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ is assigned to the immutable state variable _releaseTime
block.timestamp gates the constructor require(releaseTime_ > block.timestamp), creating timestamp dependency
releaseTime_ is compared against block.timestamp in the constructor validation
token() reads and returns the state variable _token
beneficiary() reads and returns the state variable _beneficiary
releaseTime() reads and returns the state variable _releaseTime
release() checks require(block.timestamp >= releaseTime()), making execution dependent on the timestamp
release() calls releaseTime() to obtain the release timestamp for its require check
release() calls token() to obtain the ERC20 interface used for balance and transfer
release() calls beneficiary() to obtain the recipient of the transfer
The IERC20 returned by token() is the receiver of the safeTransfer external call
The address returned by beneficiary() is the external recipient of the token transfer
Local amount (timelock balance) is passed as the transfer value to safeTransfer
release() performs an external call into the token contract via safeTransfer, transferring control to an untrusted address before the function completes
getLockedAmount() calls token() to fetch the ERC20 interface for balanceOf
getLockedAmount() stores the token balance in the local variable amount_getLocked and returns it

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only used to initialize the _token state variable inside the constructor; it carries no independent behavior and is absorbed by the constructor core node
Constructor parameter only used to initialize the _beneficiary state variable inside the constructor; it carries no independent behavior and is absorbed by the constructor core node
Constructor parameter used only for the block.timestamp require check and assignment to _releaseTime within the constructor; it is absorbed by the constructor core node
Local variable amount is consumed directly as the value argument of the safeTransfer external call in release(); it is merged into that unsafe operation node
Local variable amount_getLocked exists only to hold and return the balance read inside getLockedAmount(); it is merged into that core function node
